If your symptoms feel severe, are getting worse quickly, or include warning signs like chest pain, difficulty breathing, sudden weakness, or thoughts of self-harm, please contact urgent care or your local emergency number.

meta.title: Privacy
meta.description: How HealthOS collects, uses, and protects your health data.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: We are not yet a regulated medical-records platform. This page describes the data we collect today and the controls you have.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: Account profile, your health logs (vitals, meals, reminders, appointments), AI conversation history, and device-sync payloads from connected providers.

use.title: How we use it
use.body: To compute reports, populate dashboards, generate AI summaries, and send reminders you opt into. Marketing emails are off by default.

share.title: Who we share it with
share.body: Only the AI worker that generates summaries (no third-party analytics by default), and recipients you explicitly invite via the share-report flow.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: Your account data stays until you delete it. Anonymised aggregates may be retained for service improvement.

rights.title: Your controls
rights.body: Export everything from Settings → Privacy → Download. Delete your account from Settings → Privacy → Delete. Both actions are irreversible.

contact.title: Questions
contact.body: Email privacy@healthos.vn — replies within 5 business days.

privacy.draftNote: This page is a placeholder while the full policy and retention table are reviewed by counsel.

meta.title: Health data policy
meta.description: What HealthOS reads from Health Connect, how we store it, and how to revoke access.

healthData.title: Health data policy
healthData.subtitle: This page covers data we read from Android Health Connect. For our overall privacy policy see the link at the bottom.

what.title: What we read
what.body: When you connect Health Connect from the HealthOS Android app, we ask for read-only access to four record types: Steps, Heart rate, Sleep sessions (duration only), and Weight. You can grant any subset; we only request what your dashboard needs.

how.title: How we use it
how.body: We render the records on your dashboard, in trend charts, and in periodic reports. Aggregations (averages, daily totals) are computed on our backend so the same numbers appear on web and mobile. We do not use your health data to train models.

storage.title: What we store
storage.body: We store the derived metric (the value, the unit, when it was recorded), the originating Android source app's package name (e.g. Samsung Health), and Health Connect's recording method tag (automatic vs. manual). We do not mirror raw waveform data, GPS traces, or sub-second heart-rate samples.

sharing.title: Who we share with
sharing.body: We do not share your Health Connect data with third parties. The only egress is the optional report-share flow you trigger yourself from the Reports page.

revocation.title: How to revoke
revocation.body: Open the Android Health Connect app → Apps → HealthOS → Remove access. Future sync attempts will fail gracefully and you'll see a 'Permission was revoked' banner in HealthOS. The data we already imported is unaffected; see Deletion below.

deletion.title: How to delete imported data
deletion.body: From the HealthOS app or website: Settings → Connected devices → Health Connect → Disconnect — this stops future ingestion and clears the sync state. To delete the records we already imported, use Settings → Privacy → Delete account, which removes everything we hold for you.

contact.title: Questions
contact.body: Email privacy@healthos.vn — replies within 5 business days.
